statement: For every integer r >= 1 and every integer n >= 2^(r-1) binom(r+1,2), the maximal relative projection constant satisfies lambda(r,n) = lambda(r), with all spaces and operators over the real scalar field and lambda(r,n), lambda(r) interpreted exactly as in source.md and problem.md.
contribution: A complete proof of the frozen factor-two improvement over the 2^r binom(r+1,2) stability threshold in the cited primary source. The proof uses independent row-sign normalization of a maximizing matrix, then replays the source's cloning and conic-Caratheodory reduction on only the 2^(r-1) orthants with first sign +1. It explicitly handles zero coordinates, signed-graph redefinition, repeated cloning, zero-row deletion or padding, and the supremum passage. No claim of literature priority is made; the bounded novelty status remains uncertain.
